description: Source code implementing ASN.1 string printing, escaping, and time formatting functions in OpenSSL's BoringSSL library, specifically for handling ASN1_STRING, ASN1_TIME, and related types with various display and escape options.

methods.name: maybe_write
methods.description: Writes buffer to BIO if BIO is not NULL, returns length if successful.

methods.name: is_control_character
methods.description: Checks if a character is a control character (less than 32 or equals 127).

methods.name: do_esc_char
methods.description: Escapes a character based on flags and writes to BIO.

methods.name: do_buf
methods.description: Processes buffer for escaping or UTF8 conversion, calls do_esc_char for each character.

methods.name: do_hex_dump
methods.description: Hex dumps a buffer to BIO.

methods.name: do_dump
methods.description: Dumps ASN1_STRING content or DER encoding in RFC 2253 format.

methods.name: string_type_to_encoding
methods.description: Returns encoding type constant for ASN1 string type.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_print_ex
methods.description: Prints ASN1_STRING with escape and display options, handling different string types and formats.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_print_ex_fp
methods.description: Prints ASN1_STRING to FILE pointer with options.

methods.name: ASN1_STRING_print
methods.description: Prints ASN1_STRING content, replacing non-printable characters with dots.
